scope: Primary entity slots in synthetic development receipts; not generic all-mentions NER or independent truth
spanOffsets: zero-based Python Unicode code-point offsets; end exclusive
accountRule: Label the masked/ending account identifier itself; introductory wording such as ending in is outside ACCT
merchantRule: Preserve the exact contiguous source name, including descriptors, case, Arabic diacritics, spacing and digit script
absenceRule: Do not treat unreviewed missing expected values as confirmed absence; unresolved role records are excluded from fitting and scoring
tokenRule: Tokenization is independent of labels; tokens and entities retain exact source offsets and text
splitRule: Keep normalized slot-template proxies, party forms, known business identities/aliases and known corporate families together; source-category topics are reporting slices, not verified template families
reservationRule: Quarantine whole connected groups touching protected merchant-category validation/test identities or unresolved annotations
reviewProvenance: Assistant-reviewed policy corrections only; not human gold
